name: gemini-cli-bridge
description: Delegate selected tasks from Codex to Gemini CLI using a strict Gemini 3.1 Pro model workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Run Gemini CLI tasks from Codex with strict model control
interface.longDescription: Provides a production-safe workflow to delegate specific tasks from Codex to Gemini CLI in headless mode, defaulting to Gemini 3.1 Pro preview with no automatic fallback.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this architecture review to Gemini 3.1 Pro and return an action plan.
Run a second-opinion code risk analysis via Gemini CLI and summarize findings.
Ask Gemini CLI to produce migration rollout steps and rollback criteria.
